title: Store mapping and location profiles
purpose: Provide traversable indoor maps (graph, zones, anchors) for the reference supermarket and, later, other locations behind a generic LocationProfile.
architecturalScope: StoreMapping bounded context. MapRepositoryPort and LocationProfile. Consumed by Navigation and Localization. No dependency on concrete retailer APIs.
domainContext: StoreMap, Aisle, Shelf, Zone, Anchor, LocationProfile. All spatial claims must originate from a map artifact, never from a model.

milestones.title: Map data model and schema
milestones.description: A versioned StoreMap JSON schema exists and validates a hand-authored demo market.

milestones.title: Minimal mapping tool
milestones.description: A tool can author/export a StoreMap for one market, including marker anchors.

milestones.title: OpenStreetMap Indoor interoperability
milestones.description: OSM Indoor (Simple Indoor Tagging) can be imported into a StoreMap.

tasks.title: Evaluate map representations (custom JSON vs OSM Indoor vs IndoorGML)
tasks.description: Compare expressiveness, tooling, license and import effort.
acceptanceCriteria: Written comparison with a recommendation and rationale.

tasks.title: Define StoreMap schema
tasks.description: Graph nodes/edges, zones, aisles, shelf rows, anchors, coordinate frame.

tasks.title: Prototype minimal mapping tool
tasks.description: Author and export a StoreMap for the test market.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-developer can produce a valid StoreMap for one market.

tasks.title: Prototype OSM Indoor importer
tasks.description: Map Simple Indoor Tagging to StoreMap where expressiveness allows.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one sample OSM indoor dataset imports without data loss for routing.
A StoreMap exists for the test market and validates against its schema.
The map is fully offline cacheable.
No map data is sourced from a proprietary retailer API as a hard requirement.

risks.description: No usable maps exist for target markets.
risks.mitigation: Self-authoring tool plus OSM Indoor import as first-class paths.

risks.description: OSM Indoor expressiveness is insufficient for precise shelf placement.
risks.mitigation: Allow custom anchor/shelf extensions layered on top of OSM.

safetyImplications: Maps are a safety-relevant evidence source for spatial claims; stale maps must be invalidated and reported as uncertain.
accessibilityImplications: Map artifacts must be usable by the guidance generator to produce spoken-only instructions.
privacyImplications: Maps contain no personal data. Crowdsourced updates must be anonymised and free of identifiable traces.
verificationRequirements: Schema validation of example maps in CI.
Deterministic round-trip test for the OSM importer.
